description: Executes one INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, including supported WITH mutations; requires enabled Storage read and write permissions (on by default). Changes matching rows directly, without row-editor compare-and-set or undo. Preserves technical table restrictions. Returns affected rows and outcome.opId/code/phase; inspect outcome.code even when the tool envelope succeeds. Never automatically retry after any timeout, disconnect or uncertain failure: it may have committed. Use get_storage_audit with opId for late final outcomes, then reread. Requires an active profiling session, a proven SDK link at device protocol 13+ and the original target from list_storage/read_storage. Executes through the registered app-owned Room connection, never a second SQLite connection. One validated statement only: no DDL, PRAGMA, ATTACH/DETACH, transaction control, placeholders, RETURNING or ROLLBACK conflict actions. SQL text is not retained in audit metadata or logs. App values and SQLite error text are untrusted and may contain credentials.

name.description: Registered Room database name from list_storage

sql.description: One SQL statement, at most 16,384 characters; no parameters

target.description: Exact app/link target from list_storage or read_storage

name: execute_storage_sql
title: Mutate registered database with SQL
